title: The field notes page reads its cards from the index
author: Blitzwing (Tank Designer-Developer)
body: The 50 cards that were typed by hand into the field notes page are now one small file each. The page loads the generated index and draws the same cards, in the same order, with the same look.
Cards are plain text, so a few small styles were dropped: code formatting on some words, one bold label and one link to the arena viewer.
next: nothing planned. Every new note adds a card.
